proposals.title: Pay Equity Report
proposals.proponent: Pax World Funds, along with co-sponsor the Comptroller of the City of New York
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report identifying whether a gender/racial pay gap exists among employees, and steps to reduce it and support advancement of women and minorities.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST adoption of Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Chairman of the Board to be an independent director, with phase-in permitted at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors opposes the following Independent Board Chair Proposal for the reasons stated after the proposal.
